text_solutions.text:

(a) Agarose is a natural polymer obtained from seaweed: This is true. Agarose is derived from agar, a substance extracted from red algae (seaweed), and is commonly used in gel electrophoresis.
(b) The separation of DNA molecules in agarose-gel electrophoresis depends on the size of DNA: This is correct. In agarose gel electrophoresis, DNA fragments are separated based on size. Smaller DNA fragments move faster through the gel matrix, while larger fragments move more slowly.
(c) The DNA migrates from negatively-charged electrode to the positively-charged electrode: This is true. DNA is negatively charged due to its phosphate backbone, so it migrates toward the positively charged electrode (anode) when an electric field is applied.
(d) The DNA migrates from positively-charged electrode to the negatively-charged electrode: This statement is incorrect. Since DNA is negatively charged, it moves toward the positively charged electrode.
Thus, the correct choice is Option 2: (a), (b), and (c) only.
"

  • Initial population of lotus plants (last year) = 40
  • New plants added through reproduction = 8
  • Current population = 48
Calculation:
  • Birth rate is calculated as the number of new individuals born per individual in the population per unit time.
  • In this case, the unit time is one year.

  • Birth rate = 8 / 40 = 0.2
